name: little-mouse-pointer
description: Windows desktop UI context picker for Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and MCP-compatible AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Select a Windows window, UI element, or screen region and share user-approved context with AI agents.
interface.longDescription: A Windows desktop UI context picker for OpenAI Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and other MCP-compatible clients. Hover to highlight windows and accessible UI elements, use UI Automation or screen-region capture with local OCR, review privacy-filtered Markdown, JSON, and screenshots, and explicitly confirm before MCP output. This read-only plugin does not click, type, or control the original application.
defaultPrompt: 读取当前鼠标选择的界面上下文
